title: Reported messages
summary: Admins: review reported messages, tasks and comments within 24 hours, and see direct-message blocks.

blocks.text: When someone reports a message, task or comment, admins see it on Setup › **Reported messages**. Deal with each one promptly: the Team rules promise a review within 24 hours, and app store rules expect it.

items: **Resolve** when it broke the rules. Tick **Delete the message** to remove it; everyone then sees "Removed by a manager".
Add a note so other admins know why. Each report shows who dealt with it and when.
**Direct-message blocks** lists who has blocked whom. A block stops both people messaging one to one.
